spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Zlan casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

spellcasting.name: Counterspell
headerEntries: Zlan casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Chardalyn Sense
entries: Zlan senses the emotions of anyone touching a piece of chardalyn within 100 miles of itself.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Zlan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Zlan has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Next of the Seven (6/Year)
entries: If Zlan dies within 100 miles of a piece of chardalyn at least 4 inches long, it re-forms from that piece of chardalyn in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The new body appears in the unoccupied space nearest to the piece of chardalyn, and another lich's mind in the body seizes psychic control of the body.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Zlan makes three attacks, using Slam or Bewildering Bolt in any combination. It can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d4 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Bewildering Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 11}, range 120 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Retaliation
entries: Zlan makes one Slam or Bewildering Bolt attack.

legendary.name: Stoke Paranoia
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}, one creature Zlan can see within 30 feet (with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if the target is holding or wearing chardalyn). {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 minute or until Zlan dies. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target doesn't act as an ally to any creature. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Zlan can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
